issue.title: fix(es/minifier): Fix `node-fetch`
issue.body:
**Description:**

The variable mangler is renaming `class AbortSignal` to `class s`. The problem goes away if I pass `mangle: false`.



**Related issue:**

 - https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/55682

body: I'm investigating, and seems like this is about SWC minifier breaking `node-fetch`, which is a super common package of ser ver side node js apps

issue.title: Pass same mangling option as terser to SWC minifier
issue.body:
### What?

Pass `keep_classnames: true` to the SWC minifier, as we are passing it to `terser`.

### Why?

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/5f7faac1e676be0819dd5d828bffed8a7105a78e/packages/next/src/build/webpack-config.ts#L953-L958

### How?

Closes WEB-1676
Fixes #55682
